hld.title: High-level design
hld.caption: Implemented local prototype. Grey links show data/control flow, not production isolation or availability guarantees.

nodes.title: Source files

nodes.title: Replay and verification

data-model.title: Data model and storage
data-model.caption: SQL tables plus embedded typed identity and study-discovery JSON. Arrows are logical associations; only delivery events have a SQL foreign key to obligations.

nodes.title: ref_record
nodes.body: PK id; tenant_code; entity_type + natural_key; valid/transaction intervals; JSON

nodes.title: alert
nodes.body: PK event_id; tenant_code; alert timestamp; source payload; snapshot_id

nodes.title: meta
nodes.body: PK key; value; reference snapshot identifier

nodes.title: case_row
nodes.body: PK case_id; tenant/event; state; deadline; priority; JSON

nodes.title: evidence_index
nodes.body: PK bundle_id; tenant/event/case; hashes; file path; versions

nodes.title: Evidence files
nodes.body: <root>/<tenant>/EVB-*.json; sealed inputs + expected result

nodes.title: notification_obligation
nodes.body: PK (tenant_code, event_id); original alert origin; payload JSON

nodes.title: notification_delivery_event
nodes.body: PK sequence; tenant/event FK; ATTEMPT or ACK; append-only JSON

nodes.title: Embedded identity + study discovery
nodes.body: Not SQL tables: typed identity claims (tenant, source sheet/row, status, conflicts); every considered study with source and typed rejection reason

case-lifecycle.title: Case lifecycle: allowed transition graph
case-lifecycle.caption: Generated from lifecycle.ALLOWED. create() chooses an initial state directly. Guards apply; dual-sign authentication is not implemented. Crossings are not junctions.

nodes.title: PENDING_EVIDENCE
nodes.body: Candidate starts PENDING_EVIDENCE

nodes.title: CLOSED_AUTO
nodes.body: candidate cannot auto-close

nodes.title: CLOSED_SIGNED
nodes.body: sign() required for closure

nodes.title: REOPENED
nodes.body: new linked case on reopen

notification-lifecycle.title: Notification obligations and separate delivery history
notification-lifecycle.caption: No FILED transition. Delivery records are unverified claims. Signing, closing and evidence failure do not remove queue records.

nodes.title: Ingested raw alert
nodes.body: Original alert timestamp + source flags; SQLite persists it

nodes.title: PENDING obligation
nodes.body: Historical Y conservatively queues REPORTABLE work

nodes.title: UNKNOWN obligation
nodes.body: N / blank does not prove no obligation; deadline remains UNKNOWN

nodes.title: Scoped independent queue
nodes.body: All pending and unknown records; credential + tenant grants on HTTP

nodes.title: Separate ATTEMPT log
nodes.body: FAILED -> RETRY_PENDING; SENT -> AWAITING_ACK; explicit retry intent only

nodes.title: Separate ACK log
nodes.body: Matching SENT attempt; ACK_RECORDED_UNVERIFIED; never legal clearance

nodes.title: Disposition is separate
nodes.body: No case-state join; obligations are not cleared by sign / close / reopen

decision-pipeline.title: Decision pipeline: actual rule and post-gate order
decision-pipeline.caption: Follow arrows to the next rule only when no verdict is returned. First verdict then post-gates. Numeric AUTO_CLOSE paths are unverified; sample emits zero.

nodes.title: Assemble ExcursionFacts
nodes.body: Explicit limits, measurements, typed product identity; all tenant study rows with rejection reasons

nodes.title: Rules 1-3: evidence guards
nodes.body: 1 insufficient measurements; 2 unresolved storage; 3 cumulative history if required: QA

nodes.title: Rules 4-5: early history
nodes.body: Facility/no-load or duplicate -> unverified historical candidate; not AUTO_CLOSE

nodes.title: Rules 6-12
nodes.body: Gap, identity, study authority, presentation, SOP overlap, Refer QA, unreadable study

nodes.title: Rules 13-20 + fallback
nodes.body: Sensor/dock history, label range, freeze, ultra-cold, cap, no-excursion, allowance, fallback

nodes.title: Post-gate: authority
nodes.body: Release / note or allowance AUTO_CLOSE needs governing study/SOP authority; else QA

nodes.title: Post-gate: historical guard
nodes.body: Any remaining AUTO_CLOSE with historical closure text becomes an unverified candidate

nodes.title: Recommendation + trace
nodes.body: Persist deciding rule and limitations; route to human review where required

nodes.title: Endpoint uncertainty check
nodes.body: Compare reported and upper-bound scenarios; changed outcome -> QA

nodes.title: Final typed identity guards
nodes.body: Unresolved product -> QA; no alias-based release without owned confirmed identity; preserve history

evidence-chain.title: Evidence hash chain and replay
evidence-chain.caption: Local file/index reconciliation is not an independent anchor: rewriting both can forge history. JSON and SQLite writes are separate; not WORM.

nodes.title: Tenant bundle A
nodes.body: Core -> SHA-256 H(A); prev_hash = null

nodes.title: Tenant bundle B
nodes.body: Core -> SHA-256 H(B); prev_hash = H(A)

nodes.title: Tenant bundle C
nodes.body: Core -> SHA-256 H(C); prev_hash = H(B)

nodes.title: SQLite evidence_index
nodes.body: Tenant + path + content_hash + prev_hash + versions; separate from file write

nodes.title: Explicit verification
nodes.body: Bind core hashes, metadata, paths and predecessor links to index; reject missing/orphan files

nodes.title: Pinned input replay
nodes.body: Decode saved event/reference snapshot; run matching code/rules; compare full result

study-discovery.title: Study discovery: index evidence, not release authority
study-discovery.caption: Every tenant-owned index row is catalogued. Missing authority stays UNKNOWN; no alternate citation or clinical envelope is invented.

nodes.title: Tenant boundary
nodes.body: Search all owned index rows; exclude foreign/unowned material before evaluation

nodes.title: Product applicability
nodes.body: Identity gate; conservative name, strength/unit and presentation comparison; no inferred synonyms

nodes.title: Authority at time
nodes.body: Approval, effective and known dates, supersession and SOP; absent metadata stays UNKNOWN

nodes.title: Exposure coverage
nodes.body: Explicit time/temperature allowance; upper-bound scenario; cumulative/once-only history never assumed zero

nodes.title: Typed candidate catalogue
nodes.body: SELECTED or REJECTED; code, detail, UNKNOWN status, source sheet/row; no uncited promotion

nodes.title: Sealed evidence / API / UI
nodes.body: Identical catalogue retained in snapshot replay; OpenAPI enum; escaped rendered details
